# wearetreed

> wearetreed makes corporate gifts with your logo from Czech wood, by hand, in a family workshop near Šumperk, Czech Republic (EU). Design, production, packaging and delivery from one place, from 10 pieces. Run by Wearetreed s.r.o.

Key facts:

- Products: solid-oak wireless chargers, oak storage cube with wireless charging, laptop stands (cork feet, linen bag), walnut-bound notebooks, custom gift packaging and unboxing, plus custom products to your brief.
- Materials: oak, walnut, ash; cork from Portugal, mycelium from Kyjov, beeswax finish. No plastic.
- Logo laser-engraved into the wood. Minimum order usually 10 pieces with engraving; samples available before the order.
- Delivery dates are agreed per project and confirmed in the offer (they depend on product, personalisation and quantity); shipped to one address or many, in custom packaging.
- Clients include Cloudflare (direct mailer for CTOs), Myco (world's first car perfume made from mycelium), Bohemia Interactive (DayZ merch), Mastercard, Lynk & Co and Green Cat. More than 50 companies so far.
- The same workshop runs Forma Studio for contract manufacturing (CNC milling, laser, 3D printing): https://formastudio.cz
- Address: Wearetreed s.r.o., Za školou 783, 789 61 Bludov, Czech Republic. Email: ahoj@wearetreed.com
